:::{#exm-ols-resid-no-intercept}
#### Without an intercept, the residuals need not add up to zero

If we drop the intercept and regress birthweight on gestational age alone,
$\mX$ has a single column, the ages,
so @thm-ols-resid-orthogonal only guarantees $\sumin \text{age}_i \resid_i = 0$:

```{r}
#| label: bw-resid-no-intercept
#| code-fold: show
bw_lm0 <- lm(weight ~ 0 + age, data = bw)
sum(resid(bw_lm0))
sum(bw$age * resid(bw_lm0))
```

The age-weighted sum of the residuals is zero up to rounding error,
but the residuals themselves do not add up to zero.
:::
